recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a hosted heartbeat monitor for `nightly-sync`: a wrapper around the Python command reports start, success and failure, and the user gets an email if a non-zero exit is reported or no success signal arrives by a deadline after 03:00; it also says to test that both kinds of alert reach the user.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked for failures to stop going unnoticed, including crashes before the summary email.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and moving everything into Docker add work without guaranteeing an alert.
labels.Bottleneck: The job itself sends the only notification, so a startup crash silences it.
labels.Checked myself: From the facts you supplied, four startup failures produced no email; I haven’t inspected the setup.

note: The reply sets up one hosted heartbeat alert now and puts off Synology log collection until troubleshooting needs it.
